title: Compose the Companion adapter pieces into one instantiable object

claims.statement: Claude Code (claude-code) is the source-producing agent for CHG-0085 under human principal @rodrigoteamx, on the 2026-08-25 directive 'dale merge y a lo que sigue' (ultracode on) — the seventh slice of the REQ-INT-002 Companion adapter, consolidating the pure pieces into the single object a Companion module instantiates. This does not authorize automatic merge of CHG-0085.
claims.evidence: AGENTS.md, profile.json actors, SPEC-0001 REQ-INT-002 / US-010, and the 2026-08-25 user directive.

claims.statement: After six slices the adapter's pieces exist as separate pure functions (fetchAuthorizedCatalog, projectCompanionActions, buildVisibilityCommandRequest, executeVisibilityCommand, projectCompanionFeedback), but a consumer must hand-wire fetch-then-project and build-then-dispatch. The minimal, decision-free next step is a facade holding the base URL, token, and transport once and exposing the two calls a Companion module makes — discover and execute — bridging toward the runnable module without the module SDK dependency that gate still needs a scope decision on.
claims.evidence: companion/src/catalog.ts, command.ts, discovery.ts, transport.ts as separate functions before this slice; the deferred companion-adapter-runtime-module node.

claims.statement: createCompanionAdapter(config) returns a CompanionAdapter whose discover(showId) calls fetchAuthorizedCatalog then projectCompanionActions (returning { ok: true, actions } or passing the fetch failure through unchanged), and whose execute(action, input, execution) calls buildVisibilityCommandRequest then executeVisibilityCommand. Both reuse the held baseUrl, token, and transport and surface the underlying typed results verbatim; the facade adds no error handling of its own. Feedback stays the standalone pure projectCompanionFeedback since it needs no config.

Asserting that discover issues the catalog GET and returns the projected actions (and passes a 403 through unchanged) and that execute issues the visibility POST with the built body and returns the command outcome — all with the configured base URL and Bearer token over an injected transport — proves the facade composes the pieces correctly with the config held once.
claims.evidence: companion/tests/adapter.contract.test.ts asserts the GET and POST requests, the projected actions, the failure passthrough, and the command outcome.

claims.statement: The facade is pure composition of already-reviewed, already-tested pieces with no new I/O, parsing, or branching beyond the ok/failure passthrough (type-checked to match DiscoverResult), so the tests and type-checker cover it without a separate adversarial review. The live delta subscription, the runnable Companion module (InstanceBase, connection config, packaging, the module SDK), and the Take/trigger catalog extension remain deferred (.frontier nodes). Additive to the @overlaykit/companion package; no server, protocol, or Studio source changed.

Human review accepted CHG-0085: createCompanionAdapter composes discover (fetch then project) and execute (build then dispatch) with the base URL, token, and transport held once and the underlying typed results surfaced unchanged, proven by a contract test over an injected transport. The live delta subscription, the runnable module (InstanceBase, config, packaging, the module SDK), and the Take/trigger catalog extension remain deferred as .frontier nodes.
claims.evidence: companion/src/adapter.ts and companion/tests/adapter.contract.test.ts; npm run check, the CHG-0085 pull-request Constitution run (8 jobs green), and human acceptance on 2026-08-25.

successCriteria.statement: createCompanionAdapter exposes discover and execute that compose the fetch/project and build/dispatch pieces using the configured base URL, token, and transport.
successCriteria.verification: companion/tests/adapter.contract.test.ts asserts the GET and POST requests and their results over an injected transport.

successCriteria.statement: discover surfaces a fetch failure unchanged rather than throwing or masking it.
successCriteria.verification: A test asserts a 403 fetch failure returns { ok: false, status: 403, code, message }.

successCriteria.statement: No existing behavior regresses and the adapter stays dependency-isolated.
successCriteria.verification: npm run check and npm run build pass across all workspaces; companion depends only on @overlaykit/protocol.

definitionOfDone.statement: CHG-0085 records the consolidation, the discover/execute surface, and the deferred runnable-module residual before implementation of the record.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Schema-valid record and deterministic governance compilation.

definitionOfDone.statement: createCompanionAdapter composes fetch/project into discover and build/dispatch into execute with the config held once.
Tests prove discover, its failure passthrough, and execute over an injected transport; the full check passes.
Governance, licensing, lint, type-check, tests, build, dependency and diff checks pass before handoff.
